Method of Attack: Authorization bypass allowing remote access to the management interface without authentication
Remote code execution and gaining admin credentials
Impacted Systems: SonicWall SMA 100 series physical appliances: SMA 200, SMA 210, SMA 400, SMA 410
SonicWall SMA 100 series virtual appliances: SMA 500v (Azure, AWS, ESXi, HyperV)
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in SMA 100 series devices
Access via management interface and VPN client/web paths without authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Requests to '/cgi-bin/management' without prior successful '/__api__/v1/logon' or '/__api__/v1/logon//authenticate'
Access log entries to '/cgi-bin/sslvpnclient' or '/cgi-bin/portal' without prior access to '/cgi-bin/userLogin' (VPN client) or '/__api__/v1/logon' and '/__api__/v1/logon//authenticate' (web)
